items.title: Preservation and Management of the Superficial Nasal Musculoaponeurotic System to Enhance Infratip Contour: A Technical Report
items.fact_zh: 226例开鼻手术保留鼻部SMAS做成SOON肌瓣并缝回，随诊8个月至3年，鼻小柱回缩与死腔减少。
items.take_zh: 死腔是鼻小柱回缩、鼻尖下叶塌的常被忽略来源；把筋膜当带血供的瓣缝回去思路对，但只有术者主观观察。
items.scene_zh: 开鼻别把鼻尖那层筋膜剪光，留一块缝回去，鼻小柱不容易往里缩。
items.fact_en: In 226 consecutive primary open rhinoplasties, the superficial nasal SMAS was preserved as a SOON muscle flap and re-secured over the tip framework, with reduced dead space and columellar retraction over 8 months to 3 years of follow-up.
items.take_en: Dead space is an under-recognized driver of columellar retraction and a flat infratip; re-draping a vascularized SMAS flap is a sensible fix, but the reported benefit is the surgeon's subjective observation with no objective measurement.

items.title: Factors Associated with Adults' Decisions to Undergo Rhinoplasty in Saudi Arabia: A Cross-Sectional Study
items.fact_zh: 1591名沙特成人中26%考虑或已做鼻整形；女性OR 7.76，收入高者探索意愿反低67%。
items.take_zh: 拒做最常见的理由是宗教顾虑，最怕的是“鼻子和脸不搭”。初诊先问顾虑，别一上来讲术式。
items.scene_zh: 先问一句“你和家里人最担心什么”，比打开电脑放案例有用。
items.fact_en: Among 1,591 Saudi adults, 26% were considering or had undergone rhinoplasty; female sex raised the odds (OR 7.76) while higher income lowered the odds of exploring surgery by 67% (OR 0.33).
items.take_en: Religious concerns were the leading stated reason for refusal and nasal-facial mismatch the most feared complication, so the first consult should surface the patient's objections before any technique talk.

items.title: Postoperative nausea and vomiting after facelift surgery despite routine dual antiemetic prophylaxis
items.fact_zh: 220例拉皮中96.36%用地塞米松加昂丹司琼双联预防，仍有62.27%恶心呕吐、49.09%呕吐。
items.take_zh: 双联预防仍六成中招，Apfel评分无预测力（p=0.262）；同做眼睑整形OR 5.67。
items.scene_zh: 拉皮搭眼睑一起做的，术后吐得最凶，止吐要提前加码，别等吐了再补。
items.fact_en: In 220 consecutive facelifts, 96.36% received dexamethasone plus ondansetron, yet 62.27% still developed PONV and 49.09% vomited within 24 hours.
items.take_en: Dual prophylaxis still failed in six of ten patients and the Apfel score did not predict it (p=0.262); concurrent blepharoplasty carried an OR of 5.67, and satisfaction collapsed to 2.19% versus 81.93% in those with PONV.

items.title: A Review of Breast Implant Pocket Irrigation With Hypochlorous Acid to Reduce Capsular Contracture Risk
items.fact_zh: 13篇文献全在同一期刊，两项临床研究有选择偏倚与利益冲突，无独立重复，唯一无冲突实验室研究不支持。
items.take_zh: 次氯酸冲洗防包膜挛缩，只有同一批人带股权的数据；连致病菌都没定。别当常规，别当卖点。
items.scene_zh: 病人问用什么冲洗，照实说：没有哪种冲洗液被独立证明能防包膜挛缩。
items.fact_en: All 13 publications appeared in a single journal; both clinical studies carried selection bias and author conflicts of interest, no independent group replicated the result, and the one unconflicted laboratory study was not supportive.
items.take_en: Hypochlorous acid irrigation rests on conflicted single-group data with no identified causative organism, so it should not be sold to patients as proven contracture prevention.

items.title: Single-Stage Nipple Sparing Mastectomy with Concurrent Mastopexy: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
items.fact_zh: 19项研究1076个乳房，保留乳头切除同期固定：部分乳头坏死5.9%，全坏死0.9%，皮瓣坏死3.1%。
items.take_zh: 重度下垂不必先固定再等二期；但这是高度筛选人群的合并率，皮瓣血供没把握别硬上。
items.scene_zh: 下垂厉害的可以一次做完，前提是先确认皮瓣血供，别为省一次手术把乳头搭进去。
items.fact_en: Across 19 studies and 1,076 breasts, single-stage nipple-sparing mastectomy with concurrent mastopexy showed partial NAC necrosis in 5.9%, total NAC necrosis in 0.9% and mastectomy flap necrosis in 3.1%.
items.take_en: Single-stage surgery is defensible in well-selected ptotic patients, but these pooled rates come from highly selected series and do not license the technique when flap perfusion is marginal.
